why: The proposals share most pieces, but A's plain beige flatweave rug and clean back-tab curtains keep the living bright, modern and calm against the greige floor and black window frame. B's dark, busy wave-pattern shag and casual tab-top sheers weigh the room down and clash with the minimal look. Both would benefit from a larger coffee table to suit the 234 cm sofa and a proper planter instead of the nursery pot.
